entries.title: DREDGE
entries.definitive_edition: DREDGE Complete Edition on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use the native PC build; no emulation is needed.

primary.version: Complete Edition with Blackstone Key, The Pale Reach, and The Iron Rig DLC
primary.why: The Windows PC Complete Edition includes the base game and the major DLC set, while PC remains the strongest fidelity/capture route. Console, Mac, and mobile versions are valid access routes, but they do not add exclusive story content over the complete PC route.
primary.how_to_play: Buy DREDGE Complete Edition on Steam or another PC storefront, or buy the base game plus Blackstone Key, The Pale Reach, and The Iron Rig DLC separately.

entries.remaster_caveats: Complete Edition is a content bundle, not a remaster. Blackstone Key contains small bonus items, while The Pale Reach and The Iron Rig are the major DLC expansions.
